contract.status: PB1 neutral contract; planned experimental work; not ratified; not part of Brontide Base

purpose: One immutable, inspectable Binding Plan for one binding scope. PB0 classified this as 'normalize': the plan facts exist today but are scattered across Cooling's 'binding' block and Catalog's flat 'resourceBoundary' and 'payloadLimitBytes' fields.

immutability.rule: Every fact below is fixed when negotiation succeeds and never changes for the life of the binding scope.
immutability.changeRule: A change to any fact requires a new binding scope with a new planId. There is no renegotiation in place.
immutability.realizationRule: The plan may be explicit data or compiled away, but both realizations expose equivalent evidence of what was fixed. A compiled realization still answers every inspection question below.

inspectability.rule: Each fact is retrievable by name from an established binding without invoking the provider.

entries.detail: Opaque identifier of one binding scope. Not a canonical reference and never persisted as identity.
Binding-scoped only; never identity outside this plan.
Why this provider was selected. Version 0.1 performs no provider selection policy, so the value records the fixed or negotiated basis.
Must be true whenever trustBoundaryCrossed is true.
Cross-trust revocability is carried-tier by default; a resolver or indirection point is declared, never assumed.
The declared accept list for the addressing-only-handle flavor; empty when that flavor is not negotiated.
SHA-256 when a copied-immutable-blob flavor is negotiated; absent otherwise.

fields.name: compactId
fields.rule: 0..65535, unique within its space in this plan.

parityRule.rule: A fixed-direct-call plan and a negotiated-process plan for the same contract differ only in 'realization', 'framing', 'crossedBoundaries', and the copy accounting the realization implies. Every other fact is equal.

compositionHandoff.rule: A resolved Component requirement and an offered provision produce a Binding Plan during activation preflight. The plan is established and the provider is ready before any ordinary interaction starts.
compositionHandoff.note: PB1 fixed only which facts the handoff must produce. PB7 declared the seam itself in composition-handoff.json, which owns the resolution record, the preflight order, the stage model, the interaction gate, and the replacement record.
